// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// THISKYHALL DISCORD API // Version 2.0 (ULTIMATE EDITION)
// Google Sheet <-> Discord Render Bot
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var SHEET_ID = (typeof CONFIG !== "undefined" && CONFIG.SHEET_ID) ? CONFIG.SHEET_ID : "TEST_SHEET_ID_NOT_PRODUCTION";
var TASK_SHEET = (typeof CONFIG !== "undefined" && CONFIG.DB_NAME) ? CONFIG.DB_NAME : "Thông Tin Task";

// ===============================
// COLUMN MAP
// ===============================
var COL = {
  REQUEST_ID: 2,          // B
  DESIGNER: 15,           // O
  STATUS: 16,             // P
  ROUND: 17,              // Q
  ASSIGNED_DATE: 18,      // R
  START_TIME: 19,         // S
  REVIEW_TIME: 20,        // T
  DONE_TIME: 21,          // U
  FINAL_LINK: 22,         // V
  MESSAGE_ID: 23,         // W
  CHANNEL_ID: 24,         // X
  THREAD_ID: 25,          // Y
  MESSAGE_URL: 26,        // Z
  THREAD_URL: 27,         // AA
  SYNC_STATUS: 28,        // AB
  LAST_UPDATE: 29         // AC
};

function getSpreadsheet() {
  return (typeof getSS === "function") ? getSS() : SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID);
}

function getTaskSheet() {
  return getSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(TASK_SHEET);
}

// ===============================
// DO GET
// ===============================
function doGet(e) {
  try {
    var action = (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.action) ? e.parameter.action : "";

    switch (action) {
      case "unsynced":
        return jsonResponse(getUnsyncedTasks());

      case "task":
        return jsonResponse(getTaskById(e.parameter.requestId));

      // 🌟 THÊM ACTION NÀY ĐỂ TRẢ DANH SÁCH DESIGNER ĐỘNG CHO BOT
      case "designers":
        return jsonResponse(getDesignersWithChannels());

      default:
        return jsonResponse({
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid action"
        });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse({
      success: false,
      error: err.message
    });
  }
}

// ===============================
// DO POST
// ===============================
function doPost(e) {
  try {
    var data = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
    var action = data.action || "";

    switch (action) {
      case "assign":
        return jsonResponse(assignDesigner(data.requestId, data.designer));

      case "autoAssign":
        // API mới: Tự động chọn Designer tối ưu nhất cho Task
        return jsonResponse(smartAssignTask(data.requestId));

      case "status":
        return jsonResponse(updateStatus(data.requestId, data.status));

      case "discordInfo":
        return jsonResponse(saveDiscordInfo(data));

      case "task":
        return jsonResponse(getTaskById(data.requestId));

      default:
        return jsonResponse({
          success: false,
          message: "Invalid action"
        });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse({
      success: false,
      error: err.message
    });
  }
}

// ===============================
// GET UNSYNCED TASKS
// ===============================
function getUnsyncedTasks() {
  var sh = getTaskSheet();
  if (!sh) return [];

  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 5) return [];

  var maxColumns = Math.max(sh.getLastColumn(), 29);
  var data = sh.getRange(5, 1, lastRow - 4, maxColumns).getValues();

  var result = [];
  var syncStatusIndex = COL.SYNC_STATUS - 1;
  var requestIdIndex = COL.REQUEST_ID - 1;

  data.forEach(function(r) {
    var syncStatus = String(r[syncStatusIndex] || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    var requestId = String(r[requestIdIndex] || "").trim();

    if (requestId && syncStatus !== "SYNCED") {
      // Kèm theo gợi ý Designer tốt nhất ngay trong payload gửi sang Discord
      var suggestedPic = (typeof suggestBestDesignerForBrand === "function") ? suggestBestDesignerForBrand(r[4]) : "";
      result.push({
        requestId        : r[1],
        sender           : r[2],
        team             : r[3],
        brand            : r[4],
        category         : r[5],
        note             : r[6],
        orderDate        : r[7],
        deadline         : r[8],
        priority         : r[9],
        format           : r[10],
        quantity         : r[11],
        brief            : r[12],
        fileRef          : r[13],
        designer         : r[14],
        status           : r[15],
        round            : r[16],
        suggestedDesigner: suggestedPic
      });
    }
  });
  return result;
}

// ===============================
// GET TASK BY ID
// ===============================
function getTaskById(requestId) {
  var row = findTaskRow(requestId);
  if (!row) return {};

  var sh = getTaskSheet();
  var r = sh.getRange(row, 1, 1, 29).getValues()[0];

  var richLink = null;
  try {
    var richVal = sh.getRange(row, COL.FINAL_LINK).getRichTextValue();
    if (richVal) richLink = richVal.getLinkUrl();
  } catch (e) {}

  return {
    requestId : r[1],
    sender    : r[2],
    team      : r[3],
    brand     : r[4],
    category  : r[5],
    note      : r[6],
    orderDate : r[7],
    deadline  : r[8],
    priority  : r[9],
    format    : r[10],
    quantity  : r[11],
    brief     : r[12],
    fileRef   : r[13],
    designer  : r[14],
    status    : r[15],
    round     : r[16],
    finalLink : richLink || r[21],
    threadId  : r[24],
    threadUrl : r[26]
  };
}

// ===============================
// SMART AUTO-ASSIGN SINGLE TASK
// ===============================
function smartAssignTask(requestId) {
  var row = findTaskRow(requestId);
  if (!row) return { success: false, message: "Task not found" };

  var sh = getTaskSheet();
  var brand = sh.getRange(row, 5).getValue();
  var suggestion = (typeof suggestBestDesignerForBrand === "function") ? suggestBestDesignerForBrand(brand) : "HUYNH";
  var bestDesigner = suggestion.split(" (")[0].trim();

  var res = assignDesigner(requestId, bestDesigner);
  res.assignedDesigner = bestDesigner;
  res.suggestionDetail = suggestion;
  return res;
}

// ===============================
// ASSIGN DESIGNER
// ===============================
function assignDesigner(requestId, designer) {
  var row = findTaskRow(requestId);
  if (!row) {
    return { success: false, message: "Task not found" };
  }

  var spreadsheet = getSpreadsheet();
  var sh = spreadsheet.getSheetByName(TASK_SHEET);
  var now = new Date();

  sh.getRange(row, COL.DESIGNER, 1, 2).setValues([[designer, "Assigned"]]);

  if (typeof appendTimestamp === "function") {
    appendTimestamp(sh, row, COL.ASSIGNED_DATE);
  } else {
    sh.getRange(row, COL.ASSIGNED_DATE).setValue(now);
  }

  sh.getRange(row, COL.LAST_UPDATE).setValue(now);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  try {
    if (typeof writeLog === "function") {
      writeLog("Assign Designer (Discord)", requestId, "Giao task cho PIC: " + designer);
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    dispatchToDesigner(spreadsheet, requestId);
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log("DISPATCH ERROR: " + err);
  }

  try {
    if (typeof syncLeaderboard === "function") syncLeaderboard();
  } catch (err) {}

  return { success: true, designer: designer };
}

// ===============================
// UPDATE STATUS (Tự động nhảy Round khi chọn Revision trên Discord)
// ===============================
function updateStatus(requestId, status) {
  var row = findTaskRow(requestId);
  if (!row) {
    return { success: false, message: "Task not found" };
  }

  var spreadsheet = getSpreadsheet();
  var sh = spreadsheet.getSheetByName(TASK_SHEET);
  var now = new Date();
  var cleanStatus = String(status || "").trim();

  sh.getRange(row, COL.STATUS).setValue(cleanStatus);

  var isStarting = (cleanStatus === "Doing" || cleanStatus === "In Progress");
  var isReviewing = (cleanStatus === "Review");
  var isDone = (cleanStatus === "Done");
  var isRevision = (cleanStatus === "Revision");

  if (typeof appendTimestamp === "function") {
    if (isStarting) appendTimestamp(sh, row, COL.START_TIME);
    if (isReviewing) appendTimestamp(sh, row, COL.REVIEW_TIME);
    if (isDone) appendTimestamp(sh, row, COL.DONE_TIME);
  } else {
    if (isStarting) sh.getRange(row, COL.START_TIME).setValue(now);
    if (isReviewing) sh.getRange(row, COL.REVIEW_TIME).setValue(now);
    if (isDone) sh.getRange(row, COL.DONE_TIME).setValue(now);
  }

  // 🌟 TÍNH NĂNG #3: Tự động nhảy số Round khi bấm Revision trên Discord
  var updatedRound = sh.getRange(row, COL.ROUND).getValue();
  if (isRevision) {
    updatedRound = (typeof getNextRoundText === "function")
      ? getNextRoundText(updatedRound)
      : "Round 2";
    sh.getRange(row, COL.ROUND).setValue(updatedRound);
  }

  sh.getRange(row, COL.LAST_UPDATE).setValue(now);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  try {
    if (typeof writeLog === "function") {
      var logMsg = "Đổi trạng thái thành: " + cleanStatus + (isRevision ? " (Tự tăng lên " + updatedRound + ")" : "");
      writeLog("Update Status (Discord)", requestId, logMsg);
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    dispatchToDesigner(spreadsheet, requestId);
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log("DISPATCH ERROR: " + err);
  }

  try {
    if (typeof syncLeaderboard === "function") syncLeaderboard();
  } catch (err) {}

  return { success: true, status: cleanStatus, round: updatedRound };
}

// ===============================
// SAVE DISCORD INFO
// ===============================
function saveDiscordInfo(data) {
  if (!data || !data.requestId) {
    return { success: false, message: "Missing requestId" };
  }

  var row = findTaskRow(data.requestId);
  if (!row) {
    return { success: false, message: "Task row not found" };
  }

  var spreadsheet = getSpreadsheet();
  var sh = spreadsheet.getSheetByName(TASK_SHEET);
  var currentDiscordCols = sh.getRange(row, COL.MESSAGE_ID, 1, 7).getValues()[0];

  var updatedDiscordCols = [[
    data.messageId  || currentDiscordCols[0] || "", // Cột W (23)
    data.channelId  || currentDiscordCols[1] || "", // Cột X (24)
    data.threadId   || currentDiscordCols[2] || "", // Cột Y (25)
    data.messageUrl || currentDiscordCols[3] || "", // Cột Z (26)
    data.threadUrl  || currentDiscordCols[4] || "", // Cột AA (27)
    "SYNCED",                                       // Cột AB (28)
    new Date()                                      // Cột AC (29)
  ]];

  sh.getRange(row, COL.MESSAGE_ID, 1, 7).setValues(updatedDiscordCols);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  // Nếu task đã có PIC, đẩy luôn Thread URL xuống Cột R của Sheet Designer
  try {
    dispatchToDesigner(spreadsheet, data.requestId);
  } catch (e) {}

  return { success: true };
}

// ===============================
// FIND ROW
// ===============================
function findTaskRow(requestId) {
  if (!requestId) return null;
  var sh = getTaskSheet();
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 5) return null;

  var ids = sh.getRange(5, COL.REQUEST_ID, lastRow - 4, 1).getValues();
  var target = String(requestId).trim().toUpperCase();

  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    if (String(ids[i][0]).trim().toUpperCase() === target) {
      return i + 5;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// ===============================
// JSON RESPONSE
// ===============================
function jsonResponse(obj) {
  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(obj))
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HÀM LẤY DANH SÁCH DESIGNER VÀ CHANNEL ID ĐỘNG TỪ SHEET SETTINGS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function getDesignersWithChannels() {
  try {
    var ss = getSpreadsheet();
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName("SETTINGS");
    if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) return [];

    // Đọc từ dòng 2: Cột A (Tên - 1) đến Cột C (Channel ID - 3)
    var data = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 3).getValues();
    var result = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      var name = String(data[i][0] || "").trim().toUpperCase();
      var channelId = String(data[i][2] || "").trim(); // Cột C
      if (name) {
        result.push({
          name: name,
          channelId: channelId
        });
      }
    }
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log("Lỗi getDesignersWithChannels: " + err);
    return [];
  }
}
